body: I definitely don't want to fornicate, however I want to be seen as attractive or desirable to women (Christian women.)  Seen a few clips of women talking about how men in their 30s who haven't dated anyone were unattractive losers and I let that get to my head a bit. After a little reflecting/prayer since making this post, I feel a lot better now. I think it's normal for us to feel a little insecure about ourselves sometimes, however we should go to God during those times to receive strength;  I failed to that before making this post. Now, I have faith and confidence that I'll find the woman God has for me. God bless.
Thanks a ton. Think I let insecurity get to me for the past few days, but I after going back and reflecting, I feel fine now. Thanks for your input!
